clue.text: Short horse jump in reverse — bullock and the ram starts now?

indicators.note: the clue gives horse before jump, and this says to put them the other way round

parts.note: to spring is to jump

indicators.note: short means the word for horse loses its last letter

parts.note: equine means of or like a horse
an ox is a castrated bull, a bullock

explanation.surface: A stunted equestrian leap done backwards, followed by livestock, apparently heralding something.
explanation.walkthrough: Aries, the ram, is the first sign of the zodiac, and its period begins at the March equinox; the question mark marks the definition as indirect.
explanation.definitionFit: The sun enters Aries at the vernal equinox in March, so the ram's season starts then.

clue.text: Place reckoning to get approval

parts.note: PL is the usual abbreviation for place in street names
an audit is a reckoning of accounts

explanation.surface: Someone settles accounts with a venue to win its acceptance.
explanation.definitionFit: Applause or enthusiastic praise is a form of approval, which is what this word means.

clue.text: Takes rest — or in-patient needs a resort

indicators.note: read resort as re-sort: the letters need sorting again into a new order

explanation.surface: A hospital patient who has a break needs a holiday spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Takes' looks like a verb but is a plural noun: someone's takes on something are their readings of it.
explanation.definitionFit: A person's take on an event is their reading or understanding of it, so takes are construals.

clue.text: For instance observe in the middle, looking up, some birds

indicators.note: in a down clue, looking up means the whole is read from bottom to top
the word for observe goes in the middle of the abbreviation for for instance

parts.note: e.g. is short for exempli gratia, for instance
to observe is to see

explanation.surface: Gazing skyward from the centre of things, one spots a flock.
explanation.definitionFit: Geese are a group of waterfowl, so they are indeed some birds.

clue.text: Verses in the role of elevated culture in society

parts.note: qua is Latin for in the capacity or role of

indicators.note: in a down clue, elevated means the word is turned to read upwards

parts.note: art is culture

explanation.surface: Poetry serving as a refined, uplifted art among polite company.
explanation.definitionFit: A quatrain is a stanza of four lines, so these are verses in the stanza sense.

clue.text: First letter about Oscar isn't as I sent to Boots

parts.note: an initial is the first letter of a name

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go round, about, the letter for Oscar
sent in the sense of thrown into confusion, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: Oscar is the NATO alphabet word for O

explanation.surface: A note about Oscar insists he is not like the writer and is dispatched to the chemist Boots.
explanation.walkthrough: Boots is a British chemist chain, but here boots means start-ups of computers.
explanation.definitionFit: To boot a computer is to start it up and set its systems to their starting state, which is what initialising does.

clue.text: Dullness of work by an urban area

parts.note: OP is short for opus, a work
an gives the indefinite article A
a city is an urban area

explanation.surface: The tedium of a job beside a town.
explanation.definitionFit: Opacity is murkiness or lack of lustre, also obscurity, and dullness covers both senses.

clue.text: Revealing 12?

parts.note: 12 across is underwear; a slip is a petticoat, and the psychoanalyst's sort of slip of the tongue reveals hidden thoughts

explanation.surface: A tease about lingerie that shows more than it should.
explanation.walkthrough: Slips are underwear, and a slip of the tongue that betrays the speaker's hidden mind is named after Sigmund Freud.
explanation.definitionFit: Verbal errors thought to expose unconscious wishes are both revealing and, as slips, a kind of lingerie.

clue.text: Boxers heartlessly wrestle in a melée with carol singers say

indicators.note: a melee is a confused scrum, so the remaining letters are jumbled
heartlessly means the word wrestle loses its central letter
say signals that the word for carol singers is to be heard, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: waits are bands of street singers who go round performing carols at Christmas

explanation.surface: Fighters grapple without heart in a brawl alongside a group of carollers.
explanation.definitionFit: Welterweights are fighters in a mid-range weight class, so they are a kind of boxer.

clue.text: Trace changes and put up opposition

indicators.note: changes means the letters of trace are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone alters a tracing and then resists.
explanation.definitionFit: To react against something is to respond with resistance, putting up opposition.

clue.text: Pull up — I'm risking going back to provide food right away

indicators.note: going back means the phrase is read backwards

parts.note: I dare means I am risking it

indicators.note: right away means R, for right, is removed

parts.note: to cater is to provide food

explanation.surface: A cook halts, risking a return to serve a meal at once.
explanation.definitionFit: To eradicate is literally to tear out by the roots, so pulling up weeds is the root sense.

clue.text: Don't put on too much lingerie

definitions.meaning: wear less than needed, put on too little
lingerie is women's intimate clothing such as knickers and bras

explanation.surface: Advice not to overdress, about underclothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Lingerie is women's undergarments, a subset of the general term for clothes worn beneath outer garments.

clue.text: This plonker's oddly vacant mild riposte

indicators.note: oddly vacant means the odd-numbered letters are emptied out, leaving the even ones

explanation.surface: A fool gives a strangely empty, gentle comeback.
explanation.walkthrough: Plonker is British slang for a fool.
explanation.definitionFit: A plonker in British slang is a stupid person, a fool or nitwit.

clue.text: Made-up new trainees without any enthusiasm initially — these perhaps?

definitions.text: Made-up new trainees without any enthusiasm initially — these perhaps?

indicators.note: made-up as in assembled or fabricated, so the letters are put together in a new order
without means the letters that follow are removed from trainees
initially means the first letters of any and enthusiasm are taken

explanation.surface: Freshly promoted trainees, lacking zeal at the start, might be these.
explanation.definitionFit: Interns are junior trainees, often junior hospital doctors, so they are apt examples of new trainees.

clue.text: Nothing in act is revolting and degraded

indicators.note: revolting means turning over, so in a down clue the whole is read upwards
in means the word for nothing goes inside the word for act

parts.note: a deed is an act
nil means nothing
taken as written

explanation.surface: A worthless performance is disgusting and debased.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone sidelined has been pushed out of the action, demoted or degraded in status.

clue.text: I make metal ornament in bed with current nearly off

definitions.text: I make metal ornament in bed

parts.note: I is the symbol for electric current

indicators.note: off in the sense of gone wrong, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A craftsman tinkers with jewellery in bed while the power is almost cut.
explanation.definitionFit: An inlayer sets decorative pieces into a bed or groove in a surface, the craft of inlaying.

clue.text: Denied working aged ten

indicators.note: working as in being worked over, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A child labourer of ten is refused.
explanation.definitionFit: To negate a claim is to deny or contradict it, so negated and denied are synonyms.

clue.text: Was this good to see with Hope and Crosby's co-star?

definitions.text: Was this good to see with Hope and Crosby's co-star?

parts.note: Dorothy Lamour starred with Bob Hope and Bing Crosby in the Road to ... films

explanation.surface: Asking whether star appeal was on show alongside the actress of the Road films.
explanation.definitionFit: Glamour is alluring allure and showbiz sparkle, the quality a Hollywood star brought to the screen.

clue.text: Work out a new name to echo this one?

definitions.text: Work out a new name to echo this one?

parts.note: to sus, or suss, something out is to work it out
Echo is the NATO alphabet word for E

explanation.surface: Puzzle out a fresh forename that resonates with this one.
explanation.definitionFit: Susanne is a woman's forename, so the clue's question about a name is answered by one.

clue.text: Granny eats fruit up — this should fix things quickly

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the whole is read from bottom to top
eats means the word for granny takes the fruit inside it

parts.note: nan is a familiar word for a grandmother
the ugli is a Jamaican citrus fruit, a tangelo

explanation.surface: Grandma wolfs down her fruit, which ought to sort things out fast.
explanation.definitionFit: This powered tool drives fasteners at speed, so it fixes things together quickly.

clue.text: Meadow pipit's outside and flew up

parts.note: a lea is a meadow, a poetic word

indicators.note: outside means the first and last letters of pipit are taken

explanation.surface: A small bird outside a field takes off.
explanation.definitionFit: To leap is to jump, so having leapt is having sprung or flown up.

clue.text: Reduction of load after discharge of energy in a flash

indicators.note: discharge means the letter for energy is released, taken out

parts.note: lightening a load reduces it
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Lightening a burden after a sudden release of power, like a spark.
explanation.walkthrough: 'discharge of energy' looks like a description of the answer, but it is the deletion instruction.
explanation.definitionFit: Lightning is a sudden electrical bolt in a storm, seen as a flash in the sky.

clue.text: Diver involved in discovering Rebecca

indicators.note: involved in means the letters sit inside the phrase that follows

explanation.surface: A swimmer is implicated in tracking down a woman called Rebecca.
explanation.definitionFit: The grebe is a water bird that dives for fish, so it is a diver in the bird sense.

clue.text: Maybe his church is to issue an edict

parts.note: his is an example of a pronoun, so maybe signals the example
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A cleric's church might be the one to make a formal ruling.
explanation.definitionFit: To pronounce is to declare formally or officially, as an authority does with a decree.

clue.text: This indicates what should be strenuous from beginning to end

indicators.note: the first letter of the word for strenuous is shifted to the end

parts.note: a tough task is a strenuous one

explanation.surface: A statement about what must be hard work all the way through.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun ought means duty or obligation, that which is right and ought to be done.

clue.text: Got up as a dame discerns gross misbehaving

indicators.note: misbehaving means the letters behave out of order and are rearranged

explanation.surface: A pantomime actor in drag notices some disgraceful conduct.
explanation.walkthrough: A pantomime dame is a comic female role in British Christmas theatre, traditionally played by a man in women's clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Dressing up as a pantomime dame means a man wearing women's clothes, the practice of drag.
